info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Savings Account Creation API
info.description: The Savings Account Creation API allows financial institutions to seamlessly open new savings accounts for customers. This endpoint facilitates the registration process, capturing essential customer details and preferences for tailored savings solutions. Typical users include bank employees and financial service providers who require an efficient method to onboard customers and manage their savings needs. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance customer satisfaction and streamline account management workflows.

post.summary: Create a new savings account for a specific customer.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a new savings account associated with the customer identified by their unique ID, enhancing their banking services and account options.

requestBody.description: The request body must specify the details necessary to create a new savings account for the customer identified by CUST-100045. It should include relevant information such as account type, initial deposit amount, and any specific settings for the savings account.
